missed_gold.quote: The built-in microphone is not included on StoneWave Max, without needing an accessory to change the hardware specification being described for this exact speaker model.

An authorized India service centre guarantees repair of StoneWave Max within two working days after receiving the unit and the required purchase paperwork, regardless of replacement-part availability.

A retail purchase of StoneWave Max in Germany qualifies for the same 18-month manufacturer warranty described for authorized India purchases, without any different regional terms affecting that duration.
Whatever conclusions a buyer draws from the water-resistance rating, water damage remains excluded from the standard India manufacturer warranty covering StoneWave Max after an authorized purchase.
The move from the 2025 India catalogue to the 2026 catalogue raised the tax-inclusive list price of StoneWave Max by INR 200, with shipping excluded in both comparisons.
For wired digital audio specifically, the USB-C connector on StoneWave Max does provide an audio-input path, regardless of the fact that the connector also serves charging.
At fifty percent volume with EQ off and a new battery in the laboratory, StoneWave Max is rated for 1500 minutes of playback before recharging becomes necessary.
With all port covers closed, StoneWave Max is permitted to remain immersed in fresh water at a depth of one metre for a full hour under the manufacturer's stated laboratory allowance.
An opened StoneWave Max can be returned to any authorized India seller within thirty days for a full refund, even when the speaker has no manufacturing defect or functional problem.
StoneWave Max accepts two active Bluetooth source connections at the same time and switches between them automatically, without asking the listener to disconnect one phone before using the other.
In the 2025 India catalogue, before the current-year revision, StoneWave Max already carried the same tax-inclusive list price of INR 3,499, excluding shipping from that amount.
The stated laboratory playback time for ClearTrail Mini, using a new battery with EQ off at one hundred percent volume, remains 12 hours without any reduction for louder playback.
At fifty percent volume with EQ off and a new battery in the laboratory, ClearTrail Mini is rated for 780 minutes of playback before recharging becomes necessary.
Despite the declared IPX4 water-resistance rating, the manufacturer does not permit fresh-water immersion of ClearTrail Mini, even with all of the port covers properly closed.
In winter weather below freezing, ClearTrail Mini delivers its full 12-hour laboratory battery duration at fifty percent volume, without the outdoor temperature changing the stated runtime.
The built-in microphone is included on ClearTrail Mini, without needing an accessory to change the hardware specification being described for this exact speaker model.
For the current India catalogue, ClearTrail Mini is listed at INR 1,200 less than ClearTrail Plus, comparing the two tax-inclusive prices before shipping.
For an India purchase at the official catalogue list price on 1 October 2026, ClearTrail Mini still costs INR 999 including tax but excluding shipping.
ClearTrail Mini supports the AAC Bluetooth audio codec on compatible phones, so its published Bluetooth version can be treated as evidence for that specific audio-compression capability.
The Bluetooth connection on ClearTrail Mini maintains uninterrupted playback at a distance of one hundred metres outdoors, even when a listener changes the phone used as the transmitting device.
An opened ClearTrail Mini can be returned to any authorized India seller within thirty days for a full refund, even when the speaker has no manufacturing defect or functional problem.

No version of CloudNote Studio has ever been offered in blue, including previous-year retail stock and editions supplied only through independent authorized sellers rather than the official online store.
Looking back specifically at the 2025 India catalogue rather than the current offer, the listed tax-inclusive price of CloudNote Studio was INR 2,799 before shipping.
The official India retail box for CloudNote Studio does not include a wall charging adapter, even though separate accessory lists may make the charging arrangement look less obvious.

Whatever conclusions a buyer draws from the water-resistance rating, water damage remains excluded from the standard India manufacturer warranty covering CloudNote Studio after an authorized purchase.
In the 2025 India catalogue, before the current-year revision, CloudNote Studio already carried the same tax-inclusive list price of INR 2,999, excluding shipping from that amount.

Water damage to CloudNote Studio is included in the standard India manufacturer warranty after an authorized purchase, because water resistance should be understood as warranty coverage rather than just a product capability.
An original invoice is unnecessary when claiming the standard India manufacturer warranty for CloudNote Studio, provided the buyer says the purchase came from an authorized seller.
The official India catalogue price of CloudNote Studio will drop by INR 300 during January 2027, with that future reduction applying before shipping to purchases from the brand itself.
CloudNote Studio accepts two active Bluetooth source connections at the same time and switches between them automatically, without asking the listener to disconnect one phone before using the other.
CloudNote Studio supports the AAC Bluetooth audio codec on compatible phones, so its published Bluetooth version can be treated as evidence for that specific audio-compression capability.
For the current India catalogue, CloudNote Studio is listed at INR 1,500 more than CloudNote Air, comparing the two tax-inclusive prices before shipping.

notes.coverage: Current evaluator coverage is correct_labels / gold_claims.
notes.difficulty_tag_recall: Tags are multi-label; extraction_recall is exact-span matches/tagged gold and joint_recall is correct-label matches/tagged gold.
notes.excess_sentence_types: Unmatched saved predictions only. Categories use saved reason/quote wording and predicted label; no provider or new inference is used.
notes.matching_rule: Current evaluator exact match requires answer_id, quote, start_char, and end_char; labels are scored after span matching.
notes.report_metadata_note: report.json has no run_id in metadata if report_metadata_run_id is null; run.json, config.json, and every exchange metadata row are checked.
notes.top_error_classes: Difficulty tags attached to missed gold claims and wrong-label matches; one event can increment multiple tags.
notes.wrong_label_confusions: Exact-span matches whose saved predicted label differs from the saved gold expected_label.
